mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can be exacerbated by concurrent isoniazid use; both agents also carry hepatotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (potassium and magnesium), and liver function tests regularly; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate electrolyte replacement and hydration.
